question: A man takes 13 hours to swim 91 km downstream. He swims 39 km upstream in the same time. What is the speed (in km/hr) of the boat in still water?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance downstream = 91 km

Distance upstream = 39 km

Time = 13 hours

**Formula used:**

Speed downstream = Speed of boat in still water + Speed of stream

Speed upstream = Speed of boat in still water - Speed of stream

Let speed of boat in still water = x km/hr and speed of stream = y km/hr.

**Calculations:**

Speed downstream = 91 ÷ 13 = 7 km/hr

Speed upstream = 39 ÷ 13 = 3 km/hr

⇒ x + y = 7

⇒ x - y = 3

Adding the two equations:

⇒ (x + y) + (x - y) = 7 + 3

⇒ 2x = 10

⇒ x = 5

The speed of the boat in still water is 5 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**
